narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a piece of life and career advice, warning viewers about the transience of being 'the favorite' in professional settings where personal relationships overlap with management. The creator uses the metaphor of an intern cycle to illustrate that many people think they are special until they are eventually replaced, urging a more realistic and self-aware perspective on workplace romance and favoritism.
